title: Outlined AI
oneLiner: Fast, accurate outlines from long-form audio — built for researchers and editors.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Teams had hour-long interviews and lectures but needed structured outlines fast. Generic transcription tools dumped walls of text with no hierarchy suitable for editorial workflows.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: Owned inference pipeline design, chunking strategy for long audio, API for job status, and a thin React console for uploads and outline review.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Built a batched Whisper pipeline with GPU queueing, post-processing for headings and bullets, and deterministic prompts for outline structure. Optimized for cost per minute vs. raw WER alone.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: ⏱️ ~1 hr speech → outline in under 3 min on reference hardware
✂️ ~70% of pilot files skipped a manual outline pass in review
💰 Predictable per-job cost envelope for batch workloads
impact.description: Positioned the stack for batch editorial use rather than realtime streaming — clearer SLA and simpler ops.
